# symbolicFunctionTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicFunctionTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicFunctionTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  Recordings with declared inputs (#3149): a VariableSet as the scope of named Reals, Vectors and Matrices -
#           added in their order, read and set by name - and esym.Function of an expression and its inputs, a
#           UserFunction without item: Evaluate, EvaluateJacobian against central differences, GetFlatProgram as numpy
#           code of the inputs, against the same function in Python; the inputs as a list in another order; a variable
#           of esym.variables read at every call; the refusals of a variable that is no input, of two inputs of one name
#           and of an input that is no named variable.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-29
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
import exudyn.cMath as cMath
import numpy as np
esym = exu.symbolic

def Raises(function, errorType):
    """1 if function raises errorType, else 0"""
    try:
        function()
    except errorType:
        return 1
    return 0

failed = 0

#the scope: the variables of three kinds, in their order
scope = esym.VariableSet()
q = scope.Add('q', [1., 2.])
t = scope.Add('t', 0.5)
K = scope.Add('K', [[2., -1.], [-1., 3.]])
failed += int(scope.GetNames() != ['q', 't', 'K'] or scope.NumberOfItems() != 3)
failed += int(not (isinstance(q, esym.Vector) and isinstance(t, esym.Real) and isinstance(K, esym.Matrix)))
scope.Set('q', [0.5, -1.])
failed += int(list(scope.Get('q').Evaluate()) != [0.5, -1.] or scope['t'].Evaluate() != 0.5)
failed += 1 - Raises(lambda: scope.Add('t', 1.), ValueError) #a name is unique in its set
other = esym.VariableSet()
failed += int(list(other.Add('q', [3.]).Evaluate()) != [3.]) #the same name in another set

#a function of the inputs, against Python
def Python(q, t, K):
    return np.array(K) @ np.array(q)*cMath.sin(t) + np.array([q[0]**2, cMath.exp(-t)*q[1]])

result = K @ q*esym.sin(t) + esym.Vector([q[0]**2, esym.exp(-t)*q[1]])
F = esym.Function(result, scope, 'F')
arguments = ([0.3, -0.7], 0.2, np.array([[1., 0.5], [0.5, 2.]]))
difference = np.max(np.abs(np.array(F.Evaluate(*arguments)) - Python(*arguments)))
exu.Print('esym.Function against Python:', difference)
failed += int(difference != 0.)

#its Jacobian by an input, against central differences
jacobian = F.EvaluateJacobian('q', *arguments)
differences = np.array([(Python(arguments[0] + 1e-6*e, *arguments[1:]) - Python(arguments[0] - 1e-6*e, *arguments[1:]))/2e-6
                        for e in np.eye(2)]).T
difference = np.max(np.abs(jacobian - differences))
exu.Print('EvaluateJacobian against central differences:', difference)
failed += int(not difference < 1e-8)

#its flat program as numpy code, a function of the inputs
space = {}
exec(F.GetFlatProgram(format='numpy'), space)
difference = np.max(np.abs(np.array(space['F'](*arguments)) - Python(*arguments)))
failed += int(difference != 0. or 'def F(q, t, K):' not in F.GetFlatProgram(format='numpy'))

#the inputs as a list, in another order; a variable of esym.variables read at every call
esym.variables.Set('symbolicFunctionTestGain', 2.) #a name no other test model uses: the set is global
gain = esym.variables.Get('symbolicFunctionTestGain')
G = esym.Function(gain*t*q[1], [t, q], 'G')
failed += int(G.Evaluate(3., [0., 5.]) != 30.)
esym.variables.Set('symbolicFunctionTestGain', 4.)
failed += int(G.Evaluate(3., [0., 5.]) != 60.)

#what is refused
x = esym.Real('x', 1.)
failed += 1 - Raises(lambda: esym.Function(x*t, [t], 'H'), ValueError) #x is no input
failed += 1 - Raises(lambda: esym.Function(t, [t, esym.Real('t', 1.)], 'H'), ValueError) #two inputs of one name
failed += 1 - Raises(lambda: esym.Function(t, [t + 1], 'H'), ValueError) #an input that is no named variable

u = failed
exu.Print('solution of symbolicFunctionTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
